text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah... Where do I even begin?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was so determined to make you<n>smile this time
around, but I keep<n>getting these sorts of results...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If this keeps up, I'll just be dragging<n>you down...
choice_data_list: There's no need to get so worked up.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If I give up now, then all<n>of your hard
work will go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's one thing I will never do. Mark<n>my words.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer... How are you always so<n>kind?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's the strength of your spirit<n>that allows you
to be so nice.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... How is it that someone so<n>cute can guide
me with such<n>confidence?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I promise to repay you for your<n>goodwill. I'll get
first place... for you.
